summaries.summary: The image illustrates different types of behavior categorized in concentric layers, with 'PREDICTIVE' as the outermost layer. It is associated with 'Distance from predicted position of goal steers the behavior' and is presented as a higher-level behavior type compared to others like PASSIVE, ACTIVE, RANDOM, PURPOSEFUL, and TELEOLOGIC.
key_facts: PREDICTIVE is the outermost layer in the behavior model.
PREDICTIVE behavior is steered by 'Distance from predicted position of goal'.
The diagram was presented by Vincenzo De Florio, INRIA, on 14 Nov. 2014.
visible_text: System is the source of the output energy
Distance from the goal steers the behavior
